listing.name: Onslaught Sleek
listing.summary: We present Onslaught sleek a prototype Hegemony Onslaught that was never supposed to see production besides for a test demonstration!
listing.aiSummary: Adds a rare prototype Hegemony Onslaught ship available in merc fleets and markets.

description:
A mod made by me and @joebob73 on discord, with the sprite provided by @Moosin reddit name Moosin_Pyrett "Full permission was given to use sprite.
We present Onslaught sleek a prototype Hegemony Onslaught that was never supposed to see production besides for a test demonstration! It now circulates through merc fleets and markets but at a very rare chance so be on the lookout in them markets and possibly take a shot at the merc fleet to try out this baby for yourself!
but beware the mercs weren't the only ones to get ahold of this prototype....face a terrifying bounty fleet and claim it for yourself? or let it roam causing chaos to pathers mercs and explorers alike!

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1The8iLcjbV8d4zcMBfiTyZbKDxJxBqAx/view?usp=sharing

You thought the Sleeks were bad? how about trying your hand at this new bounty ship try not to become ONE WITH IT

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=12896.msg471178#msg471178 link to forum post for use of the fleshslaught image

Version 1.2 Update: Fixed Crash issue involving the stabilized shield emitter thanks to KWHWWYMWN on the Starsector discord! Version 1.2 IS save compatible we fixed it
Version 1.3 Update: More balancing better descriptions named manufacturer changed system of bounty ship to better reflect its uniqueness IS save compatible
Version 1.4 Update: Even more balancing bounty's have there own custom portraits NEW BOUNTY SHIP TO FIGHT AND OBTAIN still save compatible

aiDescription: Introduces a unique variant of the Hegemony Onslaught that appears rarely in mercenary fleets and markets. Players can encounter this ship as part of terrifying bounty fleets, offering a chance to claim it or fight against it.
